run_OwlViTForObjectDetection_forward: run text-guided object detection on an image using OwlViTForObjectDetection forward method with input_ids and pixel_values
run_OwlViTForObjectDetection_image_guide: run image-guided object detection to find similar objects between a target image and a query image using image_guided_detection
run_OwlViTModel_forward: run image-text contrastive similarity scoring using OwlViTModel forward with input_ids and pixel_values to compute logits_per_image and logits_per_text
run_OwlViTModel_get_image_features: run image feature extraction using OwlViTModel get_image_features method to obtain projected image embeddings from pixel_values
run_OwlViTModel_get_text_features: run text feature extraction using OwlViTModel get_text_features method to obtain projected text embeddings from input_ids and attention_mask
